name: eligible_nationality_condition
desc: The student must be a Greek national or a national of another European Union Member State.

name: valid_academic_identity_card_condition
desc: The student must hold a valid academic identity card.

name: rented_accommodation_outside_principal_residence_condition
desc: The student must live, for study purposes, in rented accommodation in a city other than that of their principal residence.

name: minimum_lease_duration_condition
desc: The lease must be valid for at least six months.

name: no_student_or_parent_residence_in_rental_city_condition
desc: Neither the student nor their parents may hold full ownership or usufruct rights over a residence in the city where the student rents accommodation.

name: family_income_threshold_condition
desc: The annual family income for the preceding year must not exceed €30,000, increased by €3,000 for each dependent child beyond the first.

name: total_qualifying_residential_property_area_condition
desc: The student’s parents, or the student themself, must not own or hold usufruct rights over residences—whether owner-occupied or rented out—exceeding a total of 200 sq. m. Residences or apartments located in a municipality or community with fewer than 3,000 inhabitants are excluded from this calculation.

name: minimum_passed_courses_condition
desc: The student must have successfully passed examinations in at least half of the courses of the preceding academic year for which the allowance is requested.

name: parent_beneficiary_requirements_condition
desc: Where a parent is the beneficiary: the student’s and the supporting parent’s Tax Identification Numbers (AFM) must be declared; if the parents are divorced or legally separated, the beneficiary is the parent who supports the student; and the supporting parent must have submitted an income tax return for the year in which the housing-allowance application is made.

name: exceptional_student_beneficiary_condition
desc: The student may exceptionally be the beneficiary if they are orphaned of both parents; have parents residing abroad; are over 25 years old; or are required to submit an income tax return and are not considered a dependent member under Article 11 of Law 4172/2013. In this case, only the spouse’s AFM, if applicable, is declared.

name: cohabitation_enhanced_allowance_condition
desc: To qualify for the enhanced allowance due to cohabitation, the cohabiting person must be another undergraduate student at a higher education institution pursuing their first degree; not have exceeded the prescribed period of study; not already hold another higher-education degree; study in the same city or regional unit as the student; be named as the tenant, or be included as a dependent child in the tenant's tax return under the declared AFM; and be included as a tenant in the submitted lease.
